document.title: Moving jobs away from the capital
document.question:
In many countries, most major companies and government offices are concentrated in the capital city. Some people believe that governments should encourage them to move to smaller towns and cities in other regions.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
